ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white/light tan) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field with a dense cluster of low-intensity circular maculae distributed across both lobes; a large contiguous low-intensity region is concentrated at the lower axial peduncle junction; tan-pigmented contiguous blobs are located in the upper-mid-region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels, characterized by sharp triangular peaks and rounded valleys along the continuous horizontal boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning into sharp, tapered distal tips with a slight upward vertical displacement.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density spatial detection of circular, high-contrast pixel clusters (black centers with white peri-scarring) consistent with barnacle attachment, predominantly concentrated along the leading edges and distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization creating irregular, high-relief protrusions on the distal edges of both lobes; visible loss of skin integrity at the left lobe tip due to parasitic or mechanical accumulation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique ochre-toned pigmentation patches located in the central-lateral zones of both fluke lobes, distinct from standard black/white binary pigmentation.
